Content: The single-host /health dashboard exposes operator-facing runtime configuration and storage health from OperationalDiagnosticsService. GET /api/diagnostics is protected by signed-in Admin policy and returns redacted configuration, configured URLs, Windows Service name, source-link roots, data/event/vars path status, endpoint links, operational warnings, and StorageDiagnostics corrupt-file information. HealthStats.razor renders those diagnostics beside stats, readiness, activity charts, maintenance telemetry, and recent in-session events so a service operator can verify the running app without inspecting local files. The diagnostics warning list currently flags AllowRemoteApi=true without an API key as a high-severity configuration risk.
Title: Operational Diagnostics Dashboard
